parsed_response.rationale:
The current low-level goals (LLGs) comprehensively cover the parent high-level goal (HLG) of 'Ensure transparent and traceable product sourcing'. They document functional interactions that enable customers to make informed purchasing decisions by providing detailed information about product origin, quality, and availability. Each LLG is supported by documented system operations and does not require a manual trigger by the customer actor for automatic effects.

LLG_001 (View product origin details) supports the HLG by allowing customers to access detailed product information, including origin and quality certifications.
LLG_002 (Browse and compare farmer offers) enables customers to evaluate different products from various farmers, considering prices, quantities, and characteristics.
LLG_003 (Place an order for selected products) facilitates the customer's decision-making process by allowing them to submit orders with minimum quantity constraints.
LLG_004 (Modify order due to availability constraints) accommodates situations where product availability is insufficient, applying precedence rules and fair-play score to adjust orders accordingly.
LLG_005 (Review and accept modified order) ensures customers are aware of changes made to their orders and explicitly approve the updated versions before proceeding.
LLG_006 (Cancel order due to complete unavailability) protects customer interests by automatically cancelling orders when all products become unavailable, with proper notification.

No unsupported or misleading LLGs were identified. All essential documented capabilities of the parent HLG are present, supported, and distinct.
